title: Agenda event
description: An event in an agenda, such as a conference, meetup or knowledge session

summary.description: Short plain-text summary of the event
examples: PostgreSQL-conferentie van PostgreSQL Europe, voor developers en databaseprofessionals.
Online sessie over het toepassen van de API Design Rules in nieuwe API's.

startsAt.description: Start of the event (RFC 3339, with UTC offset)

endsAt.description: End of the event (RFC 3339, with UTC offset). Must not be before `startsAt`.

location.description: Where the event takes place: a venue and city, or an indication that it is online

url.description: Page with more information about the event
